key_point: Miyamoto waited five years for this
title: Miyamoto waited five years for this
caption: Miyamoto wanted Mario to ride a creature long before Yoshi existed. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #supermarioworld #nintendo

instagram.caption:
Shigeru Miyamoto wanted Mario to ride an animal back in the NES days.

During Super Mario Bros. 3, he drew Mario riding a horse-like creature and kept it by his desk, but the hardware could not handle the idea.

When the SNES arrived, the team finally made it real. The horse became a dinosaur named Yoshi.
